name: coding-toolbox
description: Injects golden behavior rules (Interaction/Language/Behavior/Mentality) at session start, reminds before consequential tool calls, mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop, blocks content operations on non-UTF-8 files with an encoding hint, and provides fresh-branch, fresh-pr, fresh-work and bump-version skills for self-contained git branch, PR/MR, end-to-end work pipeline and semver version-bump management.
